internal.title: Incident Summary: Checkout Service High Error Rate Due to Payment Service Error Injection
internal.body:
At 12:02 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis identified a 50% error rate in the payment service caused by error injection, which was confirmed as the root cause. The paymentFailure flag was disabled at 12:22 UTC, leading to a rapid recovery of the checkout service error rate to normal levels. The incident was resolved shortly after the flag was disabled.

Timeline:
- 12:02:45: Alert received for high error rate in checkout service.
- 12:22:26: Diagnosis confirmed payment service error injection as root cause.
- 12:22:32: PaymentFailure flag disabled after approval.
- 12:22:32: Recovery verified with error rates returning to normal.

No resource exhaustion or memory leaks were detected in the checkout service. Frontend latency issues were noted but were not the primary cause of the incident.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing errors
external.body: Between 12:02 and 12:22 UTC on November 8, 2026, some customers experienced issues completing their checkout due to errors in the payment processing system. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service was restored shortly after 12:22 UTC. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
